description.value:
An Uchiha-only genjutsu cast through direct eye contact.

The target attempts a Will save with a -2 status penalty (the Sharingan's hypnotic effect).

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is off-guard against your next Strike before the end of your next turn.

Failure The target is controlled until the start of your next turn: you may dictate a single action on their next turn (Stride, Strike at a target of your choice, drop a held item, etc.). The dictated action cannot directly harm an obvious ally or the target themselves.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is also stunned 1 when the controlled action resolves (their disorientation lingers).

system.requirements: your Sharingan is active and the target can see your eyes
